summary: 本地优先单二进制 LLM 路由+agent 飞行记录器，把字节级日志自动结构化为任务故事并代理 provider failover。
description: A local-first, single-binary LLM router & Agent flight recorder. Automatically turns byte-faithful logs into structured Agent task stories, compares agent behaviors, and hides provider failover behind virtual endpoints.
